speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: What ground holds, and what conduct sports?
premises: This ground she holds — world-fear-splitting-dread-making; this wake-one-pointed-melted-taste-formed — ordained too.
So holding, melting, wiping inauspicious stretches, as-pleased conduct resorted — may she sport in my heart.
inference: Ground held dread-making; conduct as-pleased sporting in heart prayed.
